verdict.rationale: Exa's docs describe ranked web results with clean page content. They also describe highlights excerpts sized to each result's relevance, extracted by a specialized model that is claimed to be 10x token efficient. Context size is controllable, with 4000 characters recommended, and contents are included free for up to 10 results per search, which fits direct RAG-context use. Hands-on reports are mixed: one trial user building an agentic chatbot was impressed but wanted extra cruft cleaning before LLM ingestion, and another estimated only ~30/70 relevance on a specific search. Missing for 10: independent verification of the token-efficiency and relevance-sizing claims, consistent hands-on ranking quality, built-in cruft removal for downstream LLM input.
